themes.name: critical thinking enhancement
themes.definition: Development of analytical reasoning and evaluation skills through AI-enabled pedagogical strategies aimed at fostering deeper cognitive processing
evidence: [Cheng2025a] The GRATL framework enhanced students’ discipline knowledge, research ability, and career competency skills including problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork, leadership, and self-management
[Zhang2025a] SRJs encouraged deeper engagement with GenAI-related rules and more thorough evaluations of GenAI-generated content compared to SSRJs
[Gholiagha2025] Students developed the capacity to ask how AI works, what it assumes, and what it leaves out through participatory annotation practices

themes.name: AI-ENABLED PEDAGOGICAL FRAMEWORKS
themes.definition: Structured educational models integrating generative AI tools to systematically develop specific competencies through scaffolded learning sequences
evidence: [Cheng2025a] The GRATL framework sets seven areas of research competencies as anticipated learning outcomes and navigates AI application through rigorous verification
[Yao2025] A mixed-methods research approach with adaptive personalized learning pathways and immersive interactive learning models enhanced animation teaching
[Li2025c] ChatGPT prompt framework significantly improved text analysis skills in readability, accuracy, completeness, logicality, and critical thinking dimensions

themes.name: HUMAN-AI CO-CREATIVE PROCESSES
themes.definition: Collaborative knowledge construction activities where learners interact with AI systems to produce enhanced outcomes through iterative feedback mechanisms
evidence: [Fiore2025] Students critically evaluated ChatGPT-generated solutions to modeling exercises, creating dialogues that enhanced comprehension of software engineering principles
[Ji2025] ChatGPT-assisted collaborative learning groups outperformed others in learning performance while also showing overreliance risks
[Du2025] AI-enhanced complex problem-solving increased the diversity of higher-order thinking skills interconnections when students maintained personal input

themes.name: SKILL TRANSFER ACROSS DOMAINS
themes.definition: AI-facilitated development of competencies that demonstrate application in both subject-specific and broader educational contexts
evidence: [Huang2025a] ChatMIM showed enhancements in cognitive domains of critical thinking, problem-solving, and creativity across behavioral, cognitive, and emotional engagement dimensions
[Tseng2025] Experimental group demonstrated significant improvements in AI literacy dimensions while applying clinical problem-solving to nursing case reports
[Mahrous2023] AiDental software users showed improved decision-making and critical thinking relative to RPD design choices despite age-related usability differences

themes.name: CRITICAL LITERACY FOR AI TECHNOLOGIES
themes.definition: Emergent competency encompassing understanding AI capabilities, limitations, and epistemological foundations for informed educational technology use
evidence: [Holzmann2025] ChatGPT Fact-Check assignment teaches evidence-based skepticism to balance AI's exploratory benefits against factual inaccuracies
[Zhang2025a] GenAI literacy framework addresses ethics, security, and critical evaluation of AI outputs as essential dimensions of L2 academic writing
[Yavuz2025] Quantitative improvement in AI literacy levels from pre-test to post-test with AI-supported flipped classroom applications

data.meta_observations: Strong focus on critical thinking measurement across multiple educational contexts with consistent use of technical terminology. Pedagogical frameworks show systematic implementation approaches with recurring structural elements. Emerging tension between cognitive enhancement and overreliance risks appears across multiple domains. Methodological diversity reflects varied assessment approaches including both quantitative and qualitative measures.
data.grounding_notes: All themes directly grounded in textual evidence from abstracts without extrapolation. Some abstracts contain quality issues limiting evidence availability, but coding strictly followed documented constraints. Confidence levels reflect presence of explicit examples and consistent terminology across multiple sources.
